comparisons.peer_topic: 2023 Term Loan Interest, Maturity, and Prepayment Terms
comparisons.peer_summary: The 2023 Term Loans bear floating interest rates tied to SOFR, with Term A-3 and Term A-5 maturing on the third and fifth anniversaries of the VMware Merger respectively, and allow for penalty-free voluntary prepayments; the obligations are unsecured and not guaranteed by subsidiaries.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Broadcom disclose term loan agreements that utilize SOFR as the benchmark interest rate. AMD's term loan is secured by JV receivables and bears interest at SOFR plus 50 basis points, whereas Broadcom's 2023 Term Loans are unsecured obligations bearing floating rates tied to SOFR. Both disclosures highlight the use of SOFR for structuring term debt, though the collateralization and specific margins differ.

sentences.text: On October 9, 2024, the Company entered into a one-year term loan agreement with one of the ATMP JVs for $100 million to provide funds for the ATMP JV's general corporate purposes.
The loan bears interest, payable quarterly, at the three months term Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) plus 50 basis points.
The loan is secured by the ATMP JV's receivable balance due from the Company.
The 2023 Term Loans bear interest, payable monthly or every three months at our election, at floating interest rates tied to the Secured Overnight Financing Rate ("SOFR").
Our obligations under the 2023 Credit Agreement are unsecured and are not guaranteed by any of our subsidiaries.

comparisons.peer_topic: 2023 Term Loan Origination for VMware Merger
comparisons.peer_summary: Upon completion of the VMware Merger, the company entered into three unsecured term loan facilities totaling $30,390 million: Term A-2 ($11,195 million), Term A-3 ($11,195 million), and Term A-5 ($8,000 million), under the 2023 Credit Agreement executed on August 15, 2023.
comparisons.comparison: This candidate details Broadcom's entry into a large-scale credit agreement for term loans in connection with the VMware Merger, specifying unsecured facilities totaling $30.39 billion. While both AMD and Broadcom disclose term loan activities, Broadcom's is a massive corporate acquisition-driven event, whereas AMD's is a smaller $100 million loan with an ATMP Joint Venture. The comparison is relevant as both involve term loan origination disclosures in Item 8, but the scale and purpose (acquisition vs. joint venture funding) are distinct.

sentences.text: On October 9, 2024, the Company entered into a one-year term loan agreement with one of the ATMP JVs for $100 million to provide funds for the ATMP JV's general corporate purposes.
On August 15, 2023, we entered into a credit agreement (the "2023 Credit Agreement"), which provided us with the ability to borrow term loans in connection with the VMware Merger.

Upon completion of the VMware Merger, we entered an $11,195 million unsecured term A-2 facility (the "Term A-2 Loan"), an $11,195 million unsecured term A-3 facility (the "Term A-3 Loan"), and an $8,000 million unsecured term A-5 facility (the "Term A-5 Loan", collectively, the "2023 Term Loans").

comparisons.peer_topic: Revolving Credit Facility Limits and Maturities
comparisons.peer_summary: In 2024, the company expanded its 5-year $5.0 billion and 364-day $5.0 billion revolving credit facilities to $7.0 billion and $8.0 billion respectively, with maturity dates extended to February 2029 and January 2025. These facilities are unsecured general obligations and had no borrowings outstanding as of December 28, 2024 and December 30, 2023.
comparisons.comparison: Intel discloses its revolving credit facilities which are unsecured, whereas AMD discloses a term loan secured by JV receivables. While both are forms of corporate debt financing, the structures (revolving vs. term), security interests (unsecured vs. secured), and counterparties (banks vs. JV affiliate) are fundamentally different. The commonality is limited to both being debt instruments disclosed in financial resources, but the specific terms and risks are not comparable in detail.
